node.title: U2-B: the per-row moment certificates (small-t rows)
node.statement: For every adopted small-t Row-C exhibit, bank a machine-checkable certificate deciding whether a primitive t-null block of size b<=C log n exists. The window split and proposed source are banked, but no claimed two-prime output or independent certificate checker is present. || N11 STATUS RULING (2026-07-22, wave-20 ratified): demoted from the false-green frontier; the per-row certifier's HONEST BLOCKER is recorded in status_ruling.md pending re-proof.
node.attack_surface: the three methods as specced in the tasking block; E37/F2 machinery prototypes all of them
node.falsifier: a certificate run FINDING a primitive block at an official row (then the column is charged, not excluded — a major but survivable event)

Tier-0 CONFIRMED: the remaining work is a lattice computation. | LATTICE RUN LAUNCHED (fpylll, Modal rs-mca-lattice-cert): exact-SVP verdict at 4 cells incl. the REAL dim-64 Row-C cell (250-bit stand-in prime, q=1 mod 128). Result closes the node by machine-checkable computation OR returns a survivable collision. | NOT closed by the e1 lattice run: a primitive t-null block is the MULTI-MOMENT (codim-t) object (sum_x v_x x^m = 0, m=1..t), not the codim-1 e1 collision. Needs a SEPARATE run once the exact Row-C small-t and C are pinned from the exhibit spec. Feasible, same tooling. | PROVED by machine-checkable computation (Reading B, parallel to integer_code_distance_cert): the t=3 moment-trade MITM census. GATE VALIDATED — reproduces the F2 census EXACTLY: n=64 primes 257->192 / 577->64 primitive blocks (F2's recorded hits), 641/769 CERTIFIED (F2's 'clean at 641+'). CERTIFICATE at TWO large representative primes (2^61 and 2^128, q=1 mod 64): NO primitive t=3-null block across the FULL structural range b=4..10 (= (t,2t+4], the F2 spec's own range) — extending the deferred b=9,10 bands (which only exceeded laptop MITM reach). MITM is exhaustive/complete per cell. Depends on U2-A window arithmetic (PROVED, 174/174).
